segments.text: Mistress of Takasato Ryuujirou and the biological mother of Towa. Also the owner of the 'euphoria' mansion.
"Unlike you, I've actually got my life together, thanks."
A nurse working at Murase Clinic, and is the one who often covers Towa's shift whenever the man is late for work... which just so happens to be a common occurrence.
From TVTropes
A strange young man who wanders around Shinkoumi and encounters Towa on occasion.
From TVTropes

A mysterious man who prowls the streets at night in search of prey to drain their blood of, with his victims getting a puncture wound on their neck afterwards. Because of his modus operandi, he's dubbed a "vampire" by both the media and the local community.
From TVTropes
A hostess working for Toono Masami at the Grand Palace Hotel.
Later revealed to be a special agent of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department.
Izumi Rei's estranged father.
A waiter who works at Krishna.
A quiet woman working as a waitress in Yanagawa Café.
From TVTropes
"Good grief... With every passing day, this city keeps changing. I'm terrified that one day it'll all go down the drain."
The elderly owner of the candy shop Tajima's, which is popular for selling all kinds of sweets and snacks, both modern and traditional.
From TVTropes
Owner and manager of Yanagawa Café. He makes delicious coffee and honey toasts.
"Spill your guts, and I'll paint it for you."
A lazy degenerate who only cares about his own interests. Art is his sole hobby.
From the digital manual included with r59230
His real name is Sakuragi Haruto (櫻木 悠斗)
"I don't mind if you're just having a little fun, but... don't get too crazy."

A doctor who runs a small private practice called Murase Clinic. Having known Towa since he was a kid, Taku feels compelled to look after him. His down-to-earth personality makes him popular with patients of all stripes.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Ooooh, a mystery! That's, like, kinda exciting!"
Towa's friend who works nights as a bartender at Roost and picks up shifts at Murase Clinic in between. Rei is the "mom friend" and the emotional core of the group.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"I'd rather waste my time fucking you. Come here."
A mysterious man with ties to the Takasato-gumi. Widely believed to be dead, Madarame laid low for many years until returning to Shinkoumi in search of Towa.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Do you intend to stay here forever? In that case, I'm going back to my office."
A Takasato-gumi lawyer hired on retainer. Fujieda is a cold, clinical man who adopts a condescending attitude toward Towa.
From the digital manual included with r59230
His real name is Yuzuki Minato (柚木 湊)
"There won't be a next time."
Chief administrator of the Takasato-gumi. Cunning and ambitious, Toono eagerly awaits his chance to swipe the position of leader out from under his rival Sakaki.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Well, if it isn't Towa."
The Takasato-gumi second-in-command, rumored to be first in line as the new leader. Many people fear Sakaki, but he's a nice guy... to Towa, anyway.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Anyway, Towa, what are you up to out here?"
A hotheaded Takasato-gumi foot soldier whose primary job is to collect debt repayments. Can generally be found with his friends Mayu and Eiji.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Well, our boss told us to come, so we basically had to."
A laid-back Takasato-gumi foot soldier who helps Kotarou collect debt repayments.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Yes, of course. Here in Shinkoumi, I'm a master of intel. And bombs."
A Takasato-gumi foot soldier whose interests include intel gathering and building explosives. Using the power of social media and the internet, Eiji has a network that spans the entire city.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Sorry I took so long, but I'm back now!"
Sakaki's underling in the Takasato-gumi. Igarashi often visits Murase Clinic, and he's on friendly terms with everyone there.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Have fun, Towa."
A Roost employee and one of Rei's friends. Arata is a calm, mature person who doesn't talk much.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Good morning! Flower delivery!"
A man who works at a flower shop.
From the digital manual included with r59230
He goes by the pseudonym "Fraise" on "The fourth face".
"What exactly is your angle here?"
A doctor who works at Takanokuchi Medical Office. Extremely unfriendly to Towa.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Thank you very much."
A patient at Murase Clinic. Mizuno is a meek, mild-mannered young man.
From the digital manual included with r59230
His real name is Kirihara Nozomu.
"Welcome."
A quiet, mysterious man who runs Towa's favorite bar. Likes to collect paintings and other works of art and display them on the premises.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Be sure to have a look around at all the decorations! We worked hard to put them all up!"
A Roost employee and one of Rei's friends. Honami is an upbeat person, but can sometimes get loud.
From the digital manual included with r59230
"Oh my god, Towa, you're here!"
A Roost employee and one of Rei's friends. Junko is a total party animal.
From the digital manual included with r59230
Fujieda's little sister, who was killed as a result of the events in the 'euphoria' mansion.
